correctness.rationale: PASS: At the unique positive equilibrium K=r-eta*d, maximum/minimum principles force all patch values to K. Linearization simplifies to vdot_j=d(v_{j-1}-v_j)-K v_j(t-tau). Fourier eigenvalues zeta imply modal characteristic equation z=q(zeta-1)-exp(-z*s), q=d/K,s=K*tau. At a potential imaginary crossing of z=-A+iB-exp(-zs), one must have 0<=A<=1 and frequency B+sqrt(1-A^2), with first delay acos(-A)/(B+sqrt(1-A^2)); the alternative signed-frequency branch is later. The uniform delay is s=pi/2; for n=2 transverse delayed crossing is later, for n=3 s3=(pi/2+t)/(cos(t)+sin(t)/sqrt(3))>pi/2 by a positive convex comparison. For n=4 quarter-phase zeta=+/-i gives s_rot=acos(-q)/(q+sqrt(1-q^2)); strict concavity of (pi/2)(sin t+cos t-1)-t ensures exactly one interior positive switching root q*=sin(t*)~0.5814567017105. Crossings have positive real derivative (B+R)R/((1+sA)^2+s^2 R^2), and the uniform scalar crossings also go rightward, establishing stability before and instability after first crossing. Independent modal residuals and numerical unique-root check passed; their finite sampling is not the all-parameter proof.
